content.mission: Respond to chemical, biological, radiological and explosive threats: decontaminate affected sites and treat chemical and biological casualties, working with SCDF.

sequence.label: Assigned to IDTF
sequence.action: Respond when CBRE teams are assigned to the Island Defence Task Force to support SPF or SCDF.

sequence.label: Decontaminate
sequence.action: Decontaminate incident sites that contain chemical or biological hazards.

sequence.label: Treat casualties
sequence.action: Treat casualties of chemical, biological or radiological agents on scene through the Medical Response Force.

sequence.label: Work with SCDF
sequence.action: Work with SCDF in the event of a chemical attack.

hand_offs.when: A chemical attack needs a joint response.

review.notes: Decontamination role from a 2003 factsheet; to verify against current MINDEF material. Agents and procedures not recorded (WS9 6.27.10: industrial chemicals only, never warfare agents). Owner approval and verification of 22 Nov 2026; stands for the free-text required roles.
